answer: Thirty-six islands open each epoch, each with one violet-dyed yarrow plot. A claim locks 80 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root, so ten linked fakes lock 2,375 POA. Each plot needs five yarrow bundles cut inside a 25-minute window, each bundle co-signed by a stranger who co-signs at most two bundles. One operator harvests two plots at most: ten fakes need five hands, fifty bundles, twenty-five strangers at once. A missed bundle burns 20 POA; a dye batch shown twice burns both bonds. Harvest times and dye batches are matched to funding roots, so one hand behind ten plots keeps only one.
